name: Average units per order
sql: select cast(avg(cast(coalesce("r6"."c1", cast($1 as double precision)) as double precision)) as double precision) as "average_units" from "orders" as "r2" left join (select "order_details"."order_id" as "c0", cast(sum(cast("order_details"."quantity" as double precision)) as double precision) as "c1" from "order_details" group by "order_details"."order_id") as "r6" on ("r2"."order_id" = "r6"."c0")

name: Employee shipped/unshipped orders
sql: select "r3"."employee_id" as "employee_id", cast(sum(cast(case when (("r6"."order_id" is not null) and ("r6"."shipped_date" is not null)) then cast($1 as double precision) else cast($2 as double precision) end as double precision)) as double precision) as "shipped", cast(sum(cast(case when (("r6"."order_id" is not null) and ("r6"."shipped_date" is null)) then cast($3 as double precision) else cast($4 as double precision) end as double precision)) as double precision) as "unshipped" from "employees" as "r3" left join "orders" as "r6" on ("r3"."employee_id" = "r6"."employee_id") group by "r3"."employee_id" order by "r3"."employee_id" asc

name: Customer freight/order-price ratio
sql:
select "r1"."c0" as "customer_id", cast((select cast(
    (case when sign(n) * sign(d) < 0 then '-' else '' end) ||
    cast(q // 10000000000 as varchar) || '.' || lpad(cast(q % 10000000000 as varchar), 10, '0')
    as decimal(38,10))
    from (select n, d, case when n is null or d is null then null else
      (abs(n) * 10000000000) // abs(d) +
      case when (abs(n) * 10000000000) % abs(d) >= abs(d) // 2 + abs(d) % 2 then 1 else 0 end end as q
      from (select cast(replace(cast("r1"."c1" as varchar), '.', '') as hugeint) as n,
        nullif(cast(replace(cast("r1"."c2" as varchar), '.', '') as hugeint), 0) as d) as golden_div_input
    ) as golden_div_rounded) as decimal(38, 10)) as "freight_ratio" from (select "r4"."customer_id" as "c0", cast(sum("r12"."c2") as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", cast(sum("r12"."c1") as decimal(38, 10)) as "c2" from "customers" as "r4" left join (select "r7"."customer_id" as "c0", cast(coalesce("r11"."c1", cast($1 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", cast(coalesce(cast("r7"."freight" as decimal(38, 10)), cast($2 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c2" from "orders" as "r7" left join (select "order_details"."order_id" as "c0", cast(sum(cast((cast((cast("order_details"."unit_price" as decimal(38, 10)) * cast("order_details"."quantity" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) * cast((cast(cast($3 as integer) as decimal(38, 10)) - cast("order_details"."discount" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from "order_details" group by "order_details"."order_id") as "r11" on ("r7"."order_id" = "r11"."c0")) as "r12" on ("r4"."customer_id" = "r12"."c0") group by "r4"."customer_id") as "r1" order by "r1"."c0" asc

name: 75th percentile of order price by customer country
sql: select "r12"."c0" as "country", cast((max(case when "r12"."rn" = floor("r12"."pos") and "r12"."n" > 0 then "r12"."v" end) + (max(case when "r12"."rn" = ceil("r12"."pos") and "r12"."n" > 0 then "r12"."v" end) - max(case when "r12"."rn" = floor("r12"."pos") and "r12"."n" > 0 then "r12"."v" end)) * max("r12"."pos" - floor("r12"."pos"))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "order_price_p75" from (select "r1"."c0" as "c0", "r1"."c1" as v, row_number() over (partition by "r1"."c0" order by case when "r1"."c1" is null then 1 else 0 end, "r1"."c1") as rn, count("r1"."c1") over (partition by "r1"."c0") as n, (1 + cast($1 as decimal(38, 10)) * (count("r1"."c1") over (partition by "r1"."c0") - 1)) as pos from (select "r3"."country" as "c0", "r11"."c1" as "c1" from "customers" as "r3" inner join (select "r6"."customer_id" as "c0", cast(coalesce("r10"."c1", cast($2 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from "orders" as "r6" left join (select "order_details"."order_id" as "c0", cast(sum(cast((cast((cast("order_details"."unit_price" as decimal(38, 10)) * cast("order_details"."quantity" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) * cast((cast(cast($3 as integer) as decimal(38, 10)) - cast("order_details"."discount" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from "order_details" group by "order_details"."order_id") as "r10" on ("r6"."order_id" = "r10"."c0")) as "r11" on ("r3"."customer_id" = "r11"."c0")) as "r1") as "r12" group by "r12"."c0" order by case when "r12"."c0" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r12"."c0" asc
